rows.apqc_name: Develop property strategy and long term vision
rows.note: Corporate property strategy. This model is work and asset management for network assets, not corporate real estate.
Sites and buildings, not network plant.
Facilities planning.
Workspace provision.
Facilities operations.

rows.apqc_name: Manage capital program for productive assets
rows.note: Manage capital programme. Closed 2026-08-29 by the Asset Lifecycle band: 17.4.1 investment plan, 17.4.3 financing, 17.4.5 programme monitoring. 2.4.1 still validates funding for the individual work item against what 17.4 produced.

Utility network planning. Closed 2026-08-29. 17.1 demand, capacity and modelling; 17.2.3 protection and 17.2.4 secondary systems, both electric-only; 17.2.5 pressure and regulation for gas. 3.1 continues to forecast WORK demand, which is a different thing with the same word.

Design and plan asset construction. 19222 Design assets is 2.1; 19221 Obtain asset construction permissions is 2.6; 19223 Plan construction resources is 2.5 and 3.1. 19220 Develop construction strategy has no model home.
Schedule and perform construction work.

Manage asset construction: 19226 quality control is 5.1, 19227 create work and asset records is 5.4, 19228 site safety and access is 4.4. 19225 Monitor work performance in flight has no group - the model measures after closure (15.1) but does not manage in-flight.

Commission new assets. Closed 2026-08-29. 19.1.2 schedule, 19.1.3 coordinate energisation with network operations, 19.1.5 commissioning record, 19.1.6 handover into service. 6.3 continues to cover metering endpoints.
Plan asset maintenance. The model splits this one APQC process across six groups, which is the right granularity for a work management reference.
Manage asset maintenance.
Perform asset maintenance.
Exit strategy is a portfolio decision, not work management.
Decommission productive assets. Closed 2026-08-29. 19.2 removes the asset physically; 12.1.6 continues to retire the record and 5.3 the accounting.
Sale or trade. Closed 2026-08-29 at 19.4.2. Previously marked out of scope; the disposal route belongs with the other end-of-life transitions, not outside the model.

Perform abandonment. 19.2.4 abandons in place as a lifecycle end state under 49 CFR 192.727. 8.6.6 Purge, seal and abandon facilities REMAINS in 8.6 as the gas pressure procedure; the two are hooked, not merged, because purging under 192.629 is a pressure operation and abandonment is a lifecycle transition.

rows.apqc_name: Perform waste and hazardous goods management
rows.note: Waste and hazardous goods management. Closed 2026-08-29. 19.3 classifies the stream, handles regulated materials under 40 CFR 761, manifests and disposes under RCRA, and salvages. 7.4.4 continues to cover vegetation debris.
Network operations strategy.

Develop network operational plans. 19270 create switching and reconfiguration plans is closed at 18.1.2. The rest of the group - 19268 operation requirements, 19269 network demand analysis, 19271 simulate demand and network conditions - is real-time and forward planning, and 18.0 is scoped work-facing only by decision.
Operations performance management. 19273 Plan and manage control room operations has no group.

Monitor network status: current switch and valve state, historical state data, alerts and alarms. OUT OF SCOPE BY DECISION, 2026-08-29: 18.0 is scoped work-facing only, and real-time monitoring is a SCADA, ADMS or DERMS function every utility already owns. 1.1.2 continues to capture a device condition as work demand, which is the work-side half of it. Recorded as a decision, not an omission.
Manage network faults and outages.

Perform planned network operation. Closed 2026-08-29 and the reason the Asset Lifecycle band exists. All seven APQC activities map: 19286 submit to 18.2.1, 19287 approve or reject to 18.2.2, 19288 schedule to 18.2.3, 19289 notify to 18.3, 19290 execute switching to 18.4.1, 19291 coordinate with maintenance and construction to 18.2.5, 19292 return to service to 18.5. 2.6.3 and 4.4.4 now name 18.4.4 as the producing process for the clearance.
Network optimisation and control - real-time operations.
Emergency response.
Generation. Out of scope for a T&D work management model.

rows.apqc_name: Operate water and wastewater treatment plants
rows.note: Water and wastewater treatment plant operation.
Pumping and pressurisation plant operation.
Manage meter and customer information changes.
Collect meter data.
Process meter data.
Aggregate and distribute data. 19324 Pass consumption data to market participants has no model home - it is settlement, and the model stops at validation.
Procure meter components.
Install, remove, energize, re-energize meters.
Manage and test meters.

Operate AMI. 19338 to 19341 - establish the operating centre, monitor and improve network performance, manage AMI network faults - are head-end operations the model does not cover; 6.3 commissions endpoints onto the network only.
